profile.name: Verrandy Bagus Prasetyo
profile.description: Fullstack, Rust, backend systems, and data platforms

about: Software Engineer with nearly five years of experience building fullstack, backend, and data-intensive systems.
Experienced with Rust, TypeScript, NestJS, Spring Boot, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis Streams, Docker, and Kubernetes.

description: Technical owner for Taekwang V4, coordinating delivery across engineering, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders.
Built Rust import/export workers and multi-tenant pipelines that process 1M+ records with streaming, batching, and bounded concurrency.
Reduced processing time and server resource consumption by up to 80%.
Developed product capabilities across Organization, ATS, HRIS, Shift Management, and Email Worker domains.
Developed and maintained production applications for enterprise projects using Laravel, React, Angular, and relational databases.
Designed REST APIs and backend modules for Bomba Group and PKN, and optimized SQL queries and database access patterns.
Conducted code reviews and mentored junior engineers in backend development, debugging, SQL optimization, and data modeling.
Developed enterprise React applications with reusable component architecture, maintainability, usability, and performance in mind.
Delivered frontend features end-to-end, integrated backend APIs, and translated business and client requirements into production functionality.
